name: Beryl
overview: Beryl is presented in Scripture as a precious stone of notable beauty and significance, prominently featured in the fourth row of the high priest's breastplate, set in gold as a symbol of divine appointment and holiness (Exodus 28:20; 39:13). Its distinctive color is also used to describe the appearance of the mysterious wheels associated with the cherubim, emphasizing its radiant and otherworldly nature (Ezekiel 1:16; 10:9). Furthermore, beryl is listed among the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem in Revelation 21:20, signifying its enduring value in God's eternal kingdom.
